headline: Sensex and Nifty Snap 3-Day Winning Streak as Inflation Concerns and Rising Crude Weigh

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Indian market indices snapped a three-day rally on inflation concerns.
Rising crude oil prices refreshed worries around domestic inflation rates.
Declines in key financial stocks like HDFC Bank and Shriram Finance dragged the benchmark lower.
Investors digested mixed second-quarter earnings results from major corporates.
whatHappening: Sensex fell 319 points while Nifty dropped below the 25,150 mark to close at 25,144.
Tata Motors PV narrowed its Q2 loss to ₹5,451 crore supported by a 34% revenue growth.
Eicher Motors reported a 15% rise in Q2 net profit to ₹1,573 crore but missed market estimates.
Godrej Industries reported a strong Q2 profit surge to ₹560 crore.
summary:
Indian benchmark indices snapped a 3-day winning streak as Sensex fell over 300 points and Nifty closed at 25,144.
Rising crude oil prices and renewed inflation concerns weighed heavily on financial and retail stocks.
In corporate developments, Eicher Motors and Godrej Industries reported higher Q2 profits while RBI approved a new MD & CEO for Fino Payments Bank.
